say:0:1028201001:0.text: The fruit here is so juicy and delicious!
say:0:1028201001:0.source_cn: 这里的果子又脆又甜，好吃！

say:1:1028201002:0.text: Hey, don't eat them all at once!

say:2:1028202001:1.text: Magister, you're here! Chippy and Hammie were just out for a walk.
say:2:1028202001:1.source_cn: 主人！你也来了！满满和漫漫只是出来散散步。
say:2:1028202001:1.male: Magister, you're here! Chippy and Hammie were just out for a walk.
say:2:1028202001:1.female: Magister, you're here! Chippy and Hammie were just out for a walk.

say:3:1028202002:1.text: And we stumbled upon some delicious wild fruit scattered around! So tasty!
say:3:1028202002:1.source_cn: 然后——我们发现这里散落着很美味的野果，可好吃了！
say:3:1028202002:1.male: And we stumbled upon some delicious wild fruit scattered around! So tasty!
say:3:1028202002:1.female: And we stumbled upon some delicious wild fruit scattered around! So tasty!

say:4:1028202003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we saved some for you. Try one!
say:4:1028202003:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we saved some for you. Try one!
say:4:1028202003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we saved some for you. Try one!

choice_prompt:5:1028202003.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，这是我们给你留的，你要不要也尝尝？
choice_prompt:5:1028202003.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we saved some for you. Try one!
choice_prompt:5:1028202003.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we saved some for you. Try one!

say:6:1028202004:1.text: Yeah, Chippy just found them here. Maybe someone accidentally dropped them by the side of the road.
say:6:1028202004:1.source_cn: 唔？不知道……可能是什么人掉在路边的吧，都是满满捡的。
say:6:1028202004:1.male: Yeah, Chippy just found them here. Maybe someone accidentally dropped them by the side of the road.
say:6:1028202004:1.female: Yeah, Chippy just found them here. Maybe someone accidentally dropped them by the side of the road.

say:7:1028202005:1.text: Chippy's tummy was grumbling, so he picked one up and ate it... They're surprisingly tasty and scattered all around here.
say:7:1028202005:1.source_cn: 满满说肚子太饿，捡起来洗了洗就吃掉了……不过出乎意料的...
say:7:1028202005:1.male: Chippy's tummy was grumbling, so he picked one up and ate it... They're surprisingly tasty and scattered all around here.
say:7:1028202005:1.female: Chippy's tummy was grumbling, so he picked one up and ate it... They're surprisingly tasty and scattered all around here.

say:8:1028202006:1.text: The Vaduso Mountains are truly blessed. The wild fruit here even rivals the expensive fruit sold in those fancy markets in the empire... If it weren't for the corruption, this would be a wonderful place to live.
say:8:1028202006:1.source_cn: 瓦度索山脉真是人杰地灵，连路边的野果都堪比商铺卖的顶级...
say:8:1028202006:1.male: The Vaduso Mountains are truly blessed. The wild fruit here even rivals the expensive fruit sold in those fancy markets in the empire... If it weren't for the corruption, this would be a wonderful place to live.
say:8:1028202006:1.female: The Vaduso Mountains are truly blessed. The wild fruit here even rivals the expensive fruit sold in those fancy markets in the empire... If it weren't for the corruption, this would be a wonderful place to live.

choice_prompt:9:1028202006.source_cn: 瓦度索山脉真是人杰地灵，连路边的野果都堪比商铺卖的顶级水果……要是没有被腐化，一定是很适合居住的的地方吧。
choice_prompt:9:1028202006.male: The Vaduso Mountains are truly blessed. The wild fruit here even rivals the expensive fruit sold in those fancy markets in the empire... If it weren't for the corruption, this would be a wonderful place to live.
choice_prompt:9:1028202006.female: The Vaduso Mountains are truly blessed. The wild fruit here even rivals the expensive fruit sold in those fancy markets in the empire... If it weren't for the corruption, this would be a wonderful place to live.

say:10:1028202007:1.text: Chippy will lead the way! It's just ahead!
say:10:1028202007:1.male: Chippy will lead the way! It's just ahead!
say:10:1028202007:1.female: Chippy will lead the way! It's just ahead!

choice:5:0:1.text: Why is there wild fruit here?
choice:5:0:1.male: Why is there wild fruit here?
choice:5:0:1.female: Why is there wild fruit here?

say:0:1028203001:0.text: Look! There are still a few left!
say:0:1028203001:0.source_cn: 在那里，看，还剩了几个果子呢！
say:0:1028203001:0.male: Look! There are still a few left!
say:0:1028203001:0.female: Look! There are still a few left!

say:1:1028203002:0.text: Not sure if someone dropped them or if they grew in the wild...
say:1:1028203002:0.source_cn: 不知道是有人掉的还是野生的……
say:1:1028203002:0.male: Not sure if someone dropped them or if they grew in the wild...
say:1:1028203002:0.female: Not sure if someone dropped them or if they grew in the wild...

say:4:1028204002:1.text: Why does the magister look so serious? Chippy washed all the fruit before eating, so don't worry.
say:4:1028204002:1.source_cn: 主人怎么一脸严肃？这果子……满满吃之前全都洗干净了，没...
say:4:1028204002:1.male: Why does the magister look so serious? Chippy washed all the fruit before eating, so don't worry.
say:4:1028204002:1.female: Why does the magister look so serious? Chippy washed all the fruit before eating, so don't worry.

say:5:1028204003:1.text: I also checked. They weren't rotten and had no worms.
say:5:1028204003:1.source_cn: 漫漫也检查过，没有坏掉或者生虫！
say:5:1028204003:1.male: I also checked. They weren't rotten and had no worms.
say:5:1028204003:1.female: I also checked. They weren't rotten and had no worms.

choice_prompt:6:1028204003.text: I also checked. They weren't rotten and had no worms.
choice_prompt:6:1028204003.source_cn: 漫漫也检查过，没有坏掉或者生虫！
choice_prompt:6:1028204003.male: I also checked. They weren't rotten and had no worms.
choice_prompt:6:1028204003.female: I also checked. They weren't rotten and had no worms.

say:8:1028204005:1.text: Did you say offerings? Could it be that someone was making an important offering here?
say:8:1028204005:1.source_cn: 漫漫没有听错吧，祭奉？！难道、难道这里有人在供奉重要的东西？

say:11:1028204007:1.text: No!!! How could I, as a familiar, eat someone's offering?!
say:11:1028204007:1.source_cn: 不——！！！身为使魔，竟然吃了别人摆放的贡果！！

say:12:1028204008:1.text: Chippy is going to be cursed! Cursed forever!!!
say:12:1028204008:1.source_cn: 满满会被诅咒的！绝对会！

say:13:1028204009:1.text: Wait... this can't be a place of worship. It looks more like a pit in the ground!
say:13:1028204009:1.source_cn: 而且……而且，这地方哪里像个供奉处，看起来就是土坑嘛！

say:14:1028204010:1.text: Magister, I swear that Chippy didn't mean anything. Even I didn't realize this was a place for offerings.
say:14:1028204010:1.source_cn: 梅林，我保证满满不是故意的，就连我也没看出这是个供奉的地方。
say:14:1028204010:1.male: Magister, I swear that Chippy didn't mean anything. Even I didn't realize this was a place for offerings.
say:14:1028204010:1.female: Magister, I swear that Chippy didn't mean anything. Even I didn't realize this was a place for offerings.

say:15:1028204011:0.text: But the offerings have all been eaten now, so what should we do? Find more and pray for forgiveness?
say:15:1028204011:0.source_cn: 但是贡果已经被吃掉了，现在我们该怎么办？要再找类似的贡...

say:17:1028204012:0.text: ...Is someone there? What happened to my offerings?!
say:17:1028204012:0.source_cn: ……那边，有人吗？难道我的供奉被见证了？！

choice_prompt:18:1028204012.text: ...Is someone there? What happened to my offerings?!
choice_prompt:18:1028204012.source_cn: ……那边，有人吗？难道我的供奉被见证了？！

say:20:1028204013:0.text: Not good! There will be trouble if someone finds us. Quick! Let's hide!
say:20:1028204013:0.source_cn: 不——不好！被人发现就糟了，我们快、快藏起来……

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 这地方……可能是有人在祭奉

say:1:1028205002:0.text: Keep it down, and let's see who it is...

say:2:1028207001:1.text: Chippy is sorry. Chippy didn't mean to eat his offerings.
say:2:1028207001:1.source_cn: 很对不起那个孩子，可满满也不是故意吃掉贡果的呀……

say:3:1028207002:1.text: Magister, can we help fulfill his wish and help him discover his special talent? Then, he can return to the academy in peace.
say:3:1028207002:1.source_cn: 主人，咱们能不能帮他实现愿望，找到天赋？这样他就能安心...
say:3:1028207002:1.male: Magister, can we help fulfill his wish and help him discover his special talent? Then, he can return to the academy in peace.
say:3:1028207002:1.female: Magister, can we help fulfill his wish and help him discover his special talent? Then, he can return to the academy in peace.

say:4:1028207003:1.text: But we can't just give someone a special talent. Even the magister can't do that.
say:4:1028207003:1.source_cn: 可是……给予别人“天赋”，这种事情根本不可能，就连梅林...
say:4:1028207003:1.male: But we can't just give someone a special talent. Even the magister can't do that.
say:4:1028207003:1.female: But we can't just give someone a special talent. Even the magister can't do that.

say:5:1028207004:1.text: Chippy knows this, but... Chippy ate his fruit.
say:5:1028207004:1.source_cn: 满满知道，但是、但是……满满吃了他的果子嘛。
say:5:1028207004:1.male: Chippy knows this, but... Chippy ate his fruit.
say:5:1028207004:1.female: Chippy knows this, but... Chippy ate his fruit.

say:7:1028207006:1.text: Only because you insisted I try it!
say:7:1028207006:1.source_cn: 那、那还不是你一定要我尝尝！

choice_prompt:8:1028207006.text: Only because you insisted I try it!
choice_prompt:8:1028207006.source_cn: 那、那还不是你一定要我尝尝！

say:9:1028207007:1.text: B-But Chippy can't do it alone...
say:9:1028207007:1.source_cn: 可是，可是满满一个人做不到呀……

say:10:1028207008:1.text: Even with Hammie, it's not enough... We need your help, Magister Merlin...
say:10:1028207008:1.source_cn: 加上漫漫也不行……还是需要梅林的帮助……梅林~
say:10:1028207008:1.male: Even with Hammie, it's not enough... We need your help, Magister Merlin...
say:10:1028207008:1.female: Even with Hammie, it's not enough... We need your help, Magister Merlin...

say:11:1028207009:1.text: We can't do it without you!
say:11:1028207009:1.male: We can't do it without you!
say:11:1028207009:1.female: We can't do it without you!

say:14:1028207011:1.text: Hmm... it was our mistake, after all, Chippy. Let's give it our all.
say:14:1028207011:1.source_cn: 唔……毕竟是我们犯下的错误，满满，咱们加油吧。

say:15:1028207012:1.text: As long as <style="stress"><player_name></style> can give us the occasional reminder, we can do this!
say:15:1028207012:1.male: As long as <style="stress"><player_name></style> can give us the occasional reminder, we can do this!
say:15:1028207012:1.female: As long as <style="stress"><player_name></style> can give us the occasional reminder, we can do this!

say:17:1028207014:1.text: Okay! Where did that little boy go? Quick! Let's find him!
say:17:1028207014:1.source_cn: ——哎呀，那个小男孩呢？他是不是跑远了？！咱们得赶快跟上他！

choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 你们是优秀的使魔！加油！

choice:8:0:1.text: He at fault should make amends.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 让犯错的人来解决问题吧
choice:8:0:1.male: He at fault should make amends.
choice:8:0:1.female: He at fault should make amends.

say:1:1028208002:0.text: Shh! Quiet! Let's go take a look.
say:1:1028208002:0.source_cn: 嘘，小声点，我们过去看看。

say:0:1028212001:0.text: Wind, why would you attack me...?

say:1:1028212002:0.text: Maybe I don't have the talent to speak with the wind...
say:1:1028212002:0.source_cn: 难道我其实没有风语天赋……

say:4:1028213002:1.text: My name is Hammie. This is Chippy. We are the familiars of Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:4:1028213002:1.source_cn: 我叫漫漫，他是满满，我们是魔法师<style=stre...
say:4:1028213002:1.male: My name is Hammie. This is Chippy. We are the familiars of Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:4:1028213002:1.female: My name is Hammie. This is Chippy. We are the familiars of Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:5:1028213003:1.text: We just happened to be passing by and saw you being chased by the wind elemental.
say:5:1028213003:1.source_cn: 咳，我们刚好路过，看到你在被风元素追赶……

say:6:1028213004:1.text: I-I was speaking with the wind! It's just that... our talk didn't go well. Anyway, thank you.
say:6:1028213004:1.source_cn: ……我、我是在和风沟通！只是没沟通好而已……我，嗯……...

say:7:1028213005:1.text: It's very late and very dangerous for you to be out alone. Let's get you somewhere safe. Maybe back to the academy?
say:7:1028213005:1.source_cn: 这么晚了，你一个人在外面多危险呀，我们先送你回安全的地...

say:8:1028213006:1.text: I can't leave! If I give up now, Misarte will think I'm not strong enough and take back the gift she's given me!
say:8:1028213006:1.source_cn: 不行！中途而废，弥萨忒一定会觉得我意志不够坚定，然后就...

say:9:1028213007:1.text: In case you don't know, I prayed to Misarte, and my prayers were answered!
say:9:1028213007:1.source_cn: 你们不知道，我向弥萨忒祈愿，得到了回应！

say:10:1028213008:1.text: But she is testing me. She wants me to discover my talent... Now it seems that whatever it is, it's definitely not windwhispering.
say:10:1028213008:1.source_cn: 但是，弥萨忒要考验我，需要让我自己找到天赋所在……现在...

say:11:1028213009:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as a magister, you must have a lot of knowledge. How do I recognize the talent I've been blessed with?
say:11:1028213009:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as a magister, you must have a lot of knowledge. How do I recognize the talent I've been blessed with?
say:11:1028213009:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as a magister, you must have a lot of knowledge. How do I recognize the talent I've been blessed with?

choice_prompt:12:1028213009.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as a magister, you must have a lot of knowledge. How do I recognize the talent I've been blessed with?
choice_prompt:12:1028213009.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，您是位魔法师，一定懂得很多……请问，我要怎样才能找到神赐予我的天赋？
choice_prompt:12:1028213009.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as a magister, you must have a lot of knowledge. How do I recognize the talent I've been blessed with?
choice_prompt:12:1028213009.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as a magister, you must have a lot of knowledge. How do I recognize the talent I've been blessed with?

say:13:1028213010:1.text: Within...? Are you saying I should look into my heart and pray to Misarte even more?
say:13:1028213010:1.source_cn: 内心？您是说我应该更虔诚地、全心全意向弥萨忒祈愿？
say:13:1028213010:1.male: Within...? Are you saying I should look into my heart and pray to Misarte even more?
say:13:1028213010:1.female: Within...? Are you saying I should look into my heart and pray to Misarte even more?

say:14:1028213011:1.text: Oh... You are truly pure of heart...

say:15:1028213013:1.text: Okay... I need to do another ritual and ask for Misarte's guidance again!
say:15:1028213013:1.source_cn: 嗯，没错……我要布置仪式，再次请求弥萨忒的指引！

say:17:1028213012:1.text: You're right. Maybe I got too excited last time and misunderstood Misarte's blessing.
say:17:1028213012:1.source_cn: 嗯，您说得对，或许上次我太兴奋， 忽略了弥萨忒给予的启示。
say:17:1028213012:1.male: You're right. Maybe I got too excited last time and misunderstood Misarte's blessing.
say:17:1028213012:1.female: You're right. Maybe I got too excited last time and misunderstood Misarte's blessing.

say:0:1028214001:0.text: The ritual I tried last time worked. Let's try to do it again.
say:0:1028214001:0.source_cn: 之前的仪式很有效，这次也这么布置吧。

say:1:1028214002:0.text: We should go find some wild fruit. Misarte seemed to like them the best...
say:1:1028214002:0.source_cn: 我们得多找一点野果，弥萨忒似乎很喜欢……

say:2:1028215001:1.text: Misarte, I once again pray for your favor and enlightenment so that I may discover my gift.
say:2:1028215001:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒，我再次祈求您的眷顾，祈求您给予我启示，让我能找...

say:3:1028215002:0.text: I give you your favored offering, the wild fruit that you accepted last time. Please answer my prayers.
say:3:1028215002:0.source_cn: 在此，我向您敬献您最爱的贡品，希望您像上次一样收下这些...

choice_prompt:4:1028215002.text: I give you your favored offering, the wild fruit that you accepted last time. Please answer my prayers.
choice_prompt:4:1028215002.source_cn: 在此，我向您敬献您最爱的贡品，希望您像上次一样收下这些野苹果，回应我的祈祷……

say:5:1028215003:0.text: Magister, did I say something wrong? Misarte loves wild fruit! I know that because of my last offering!
say:5:1028215003:0.male: Magister, did I say something wrong? Misarte loves wild fruit! I know that because of my last offering!
say:5:1028215003:0.female: Magister, did I say something wrong? Misarte loves wild fruit! I know that because of my last offering!

choice_prompt:6:1028215003.text: Magister, did I say something wrong? Misarte loves wild fruit! I know that because of my last offering!
choice_prompt:6:1028215003.source_cn: 魔法师<male>哥哥</male><female>姐姐</female>，我做错了吗？弥萨忒喜欢野果，我上次祈祷时已经验证过了！
choice_prompt:6:1028215003.male: Magister, did I say something wrong? Misarte loves wild fruit! I know that because of my last offering!
choice_prompt:6:1028215003.female: Magister, did I say something wrong? Misarte loves wild fruit! I know that because of my last offering!

say:7:1028215004:0.text: Right! Then, I'll continue with my prayers.
say:7:1028215004:0.male: Right! Then, I'll continue with my prayers.
say:7:1028215004:0.female: Right! Then, I'll continue with my prayers.

say:8:1028215005:1.text: Kind and loving Misarte... I beg you to enlighten me...
say:8:1028215005:1.source_cn: 慈爱的弥萨忒啊，我请求您，给予我启示……

say:9:1028215006:1.text:
Strange... this time Misarte didn't take the offerings...
What's going on? Did she give up on me because she thinks I'm too dense to understand her?
say:9:1028215006:1.source_cn: 真奇怪，这次弥萨忒没有取走贡果……\n怎么回事，难道神...

say:10:1028215007:1.text: Of course not! Chippy thinks a lack of a response is an answer in itself, right, Magister?
say:10:1028215007:1.source_cn: 咳，肯定不是！嗯……没有回应有时候也是一种启示呢，对不...
say:10:1028215007:1.male: Of course not! Chippy thinks a lack of a response is an answer in itself, right, Magister?
say:10:1028215007:1.female: Of course not! Chippy thinks a lack of a response is an answer in itself, right, Magister?

choice_prompt:11:1028215007.text: Of course not! Chippy thinks a lack of a response is an answer in itself, right, Magister?
choice_prompt:11:1028215007.source_cn: 咳，肯定不是！嗯……没有回应有时候也是一种启示呢，对不对，主人？
choice_prompt:11:1028215007.male: Of course not! Chippy thinks a lack of a response is an answer in itself, right, Magister?
choice_prompt:11:1028215007.female: Of course not! Chippy thinks a lack of a response is an answer in itself, right, Magister?

say:12:1028215008:1.text: A lack of a response could also be an answer... Does this mean I was right, but I'm looking in the wrong direction?
say:12:1028215008:1.source_cn: 没有回应也是一种启示……难道这是说，我之前的想法没有错...

say:13:1028215009:1.text: Since my talent isn't windwhispering, maybe I was granted super strength or expert swordsmanship!
say:13:1028215009:1.source_cn: 既然我的天赋不是风语，那……那也许是强大的力量或者厉害...

say:14:1028215010:1.text: I understand now! I need to be brave and keep searching!
say:14:1028215010:1.source_cn: 我完全明白了！我会坚定内心，继续寻找我的天赋！

say:15:1028215011:1.text: Chippy thinks he doesn't understand at all...
say:15:1028215011:1.source_cn: 满满觉得，他完全没有明白啊……

say:1:1028216002:0.text: With us here, at least we can keep him safe.
say:1:1028216002:0.source_cn: 有我们在，至少可以保证他的安全。

say:2:1028216003:0.text: Well, let's see how it goes. After all, Chippy did eat his offerings...
say:2:1028216003:0.source_cn: 嗯，看看情况吧，毕竟吃了人家的东西……

say:3:1028217001:1.text: If my gift is super strength, I could've beaten the snot out of that Hypofiend!
say:3:1028217001:1.source_cn: ……如果我的天赋是强大的力量，那我也可以把刚才的魔物打...

say:4:1028217002:1.text: But you already defeated it... I know, let's have a duel!

say:11:1028217009:1.source_cn: 但是刚才弥萨忒已经给予了启示，让我坚定内心，继续寻找！

say:13:1028217011:1.text: If my gift isn't strength... maybe I'm skilled with weapons now? Like the Thorned Guards...
say:13:1028217011:1.source_cn: 我的天赋不是力量，那……说不定我能熟练地使用武器？像荆...

say:0:1028218001:0.source_cn: 我们得跟上去，快点，满满！

choice_prompt:6:1028219002.female: It's long and straight! It isn't sharp, but it's the perfect weapon to practice with!

say:7:1028219003:1.male: I would like to, but I can't seem to stand straight right now...

say:10:1028219006:1.source_cn: 我、我才没被它吓到！我只是……不想伤到它！

say:12:1028219008:1.text: You must be in a lot of pain! Don't worry. There should be herbs around here we can use to make some medicine.
say:12:1028219008:1.source_cn: 你一定很疼吧！别担心，这附近应该有可以用来调配药剂的植物……

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 你不会还要和我比剑术吧

say:3:1028220001:1.text: The medicine worked great! You two really are worthy of being the magister's familiars. My foot doesn't hurt at all!

say:3:1028220001:1.male: The medicine worked great! You two really are worthy of being the magister's familiars. My foot doesn't hurt at all!
say:3:1028220001:1.female: The medicine worked great! You two really are worthy of being the magister's familiars. My foot doesn't hurt at all!

say:4:1028220002:1.text: Then let's have a duel. This time, Chippy will fight you!
say:4:1028220002:1.source_cn: 那我们来比剑吧，这次满满来和你比！

say:5:1028220003:1.text: N-No need. I already know swordsmanship isn't my gift from Misarte.
say:5:1028220003:1.source_cn: ……不、不用了。我已经知道了，弥萨忒赐给我的也不是剑术天赋。

say:6:1028220004:1.text: Even when I was just practicing alone, I poked myself a few times... A divine gift wouldn't make me so clumsy.
say:6:1028220004:1.source_cn: 我刚才试练时，戳到自己好几次……神赐的天赋才不会这样笨...

say:7:1028220005:1.text: I-I'm starting to doubt if I'll ever discover my true calling.

say:9:1028220006:1.source_cn: 您是说，我该坚持下去？可试了这么多次，都没有找到正确的...
say:9:1028220006:1.male: You mean I should keep trying? But after so many times... I'm just tired.
say:9:1028220006:1.female: You mean I should keep trying? But after so many times... I'm just tired.

say:10:1028220007:1.female: What <style="stress"><player_name></style> means is that finding one's talent isn't something that happens right away.

say:11:1028220008:1.text: Right! When you're tired, you should rest. Only by resting can one be more efficient. Resting isn't giving up. Even the gods understand that!
say:11:1028220008:1.source_cn: 对！累了就要休息，休息好了才更有效率——这可不算半途而...

say:12:1028220009:1.text: Misarte never said that, but... it does make sense.
say:12:1028220009:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒并没有降下那种启示……不过听起来……似乎很有道理。

say:13:1028220010:1.text: Oh, we're almost to my favorite field of flowers...
say:13:1028220010:1.source_cn: 哦，这里快到我很喜欢的那片花田了……

say:14:1028220011:1.text: Thank you for your help. I think I'll rest for a while!
say:14:1028220011:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们的帮助，我要去好好休息一阵子！

say:15:1028220012:1.text: Wait, Randy... That's not the way back to the academy!
say:15:1028220012:1.source_cn: ……等等，兰迪，那不是回学院的路！

choice:8:0:1.text: You will, but it takes time.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 当然，这需要足够的时间
choice:8:0:1.male: You will, but it takes time.
choice:8:0:1.female: You will, but it takes time.

say:3:1028225003:1.text: When I was sad, I'd come here to water them and get rid of their pests. It made me so happy to see them grow.
say:3:1028225003:1.source_cn: 我不开心的时候，就来这里给它们浇水、除虫。只要它们长得...

say:4:1028225004:1.source_cn: 可是附近发生腐化以后，老师禁止我们出学院……呜呜，我不...

say:5:1028225005:1.text: Can you all help me bury them?
say:5:1028225005:1.source_cn: 呜呜……你们，能、能帮我……帮我把它们埋葬了吗？

choice_prompt:6:1028225005.text: Can you all help me bury them?
choice_prompt:6:1028225005.source_cn: 呜呜……你们，能、能帮我……帮我把它们埋葬了吗？

say:0:1028226001:0.source_cn: 就埋在这里吧……这是它们熟悉的地方。

say:4:1028227002:1.text: It's just such a shame... they were all so pretty...

say:5:1028227003:1.text: Don't be sad, Randy. Misarte will return all these flowers to forests and mountains nearby!
say:5:1028227003:1.source_cn: 不要难过了，兰迪。你瞧，弥萨忒会让这些花回归山林的！

say:6:1028227004:1.text: There will be new plants and flowers growing here again one day!
say:6:1028227004:1.source_cn: 这里也总有一天，会再长出新的花草！

say:7:1028227005:1.text: Thank you all. I-I'd like to go back to the academy now.
say:7:1028227005:1.source_cn: 嗯……谢谢你们。我、我想回学院了……

say:8:1028227006:1.text: Great! Finally... Chippy and I will go ahead and make sure the way is clear of danger.
say:8:1028227006:1.source_cn: 太好了！总算……我和满满先走一步，保证路上没有危险！
say:8:1028227006:1.male: Great! Finally... Chippy and I will go ahead and make sure the way is clear of danger.
say:8:1028227006:1.female: Great! Finally... Chippy and I will go ahead and make sure the way is clear of danger.

say:9:1028227007:1.source_cn: 主人，就麻烦你陪着他啦！

say:3:1028228001:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔老师，对不起，我不该偷偷溜出学院。但是……

say:4:1028228002:0.source_cn: 没关系，我听满满说了，你是为了寻找天赋，对不对？

say:5:1028228003:1.text: But after searching so long, I still haven't discovered anything...
say:5:1028228003:1.source_cn: 嗯，可找了这么大一圈，还是什么都没找到……

say:6:1028228004:1.source_cn: 兰迪，我和你一样，既不懂风语也不会剑术。小的时候，我也...

say:7:1028228005:1.text: So, how did you find your gift?

say:8:1028228006:0.text: Although it took a long time, I finally discovered that I was meant to look after children like you and be there to guide all of you.

say:9:1028228007:0.source_cn: 你看，弥萨忒赋予这片森林无限的可能，所以万物各有芬芳。...

say:10:1028228008:1.source_cn: 可是，如果没有足够的天赋加入风语者、荆棘卫队或巡游队，...

say:11:1028228009:0.text: Have you thought about becoming an herbalist, chef, architect, or even a scribe?
say:11:1028228009:0.source_cn: 成为一名植物学者、厨师、建筑师……或者是充满想象力的作...

say:12:1028228010:0.text: The forest nurtures all different types of growth. These differences are what make the forest beautiful.
say:12:1028228010:0.source_cn: 丛林中盛开着所有的花，生长着不同的树木，正是这些不同，...

say:13:1028228011:0.text: I might know another way to help you find your calling.
say:13:1028228011:0.source_cn: 好啦……你看，我还有个办法能帮你找到天赋！

say:14:1028228012:1.text: If you love flowers so much, surely you know that Misarte does as well?
say:14:1028228012:1.source_cn: 你那么喜爱花草，肯定知道弥萨忒也钟爱美丽的花朵，对吧？

say:16:1028228014:0.text: Well, it might be a good idea to plant some more! I'm sure you'll feel the joy Misarte feels when they bloom. Maybe then your gift will be revealed.
say:16:1028228014:0.source_cn: 那么，不妨多种些花吧！当花朵盛放时，你一定能感受到弥萨...

say:17:1028228015:0.source_cn: ……真的吗？！芙拉贝尔老师，真的可以吗？

say:20:1028228017:2.source_cn: 那就说好了，我们在学院附近开辟一片花田。兰迪，以后花田...

say:21:1028228018:0.source_cn: 好呀！这个季节种蓝楹花最合适，等暖和了，再种一片月蝶兰...

say:22:1028228019:1.text: Thank you! When the time comes, I'll give Misarte the most beautiful flowers as an offering!
say:22:1028228019:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们！到时候，我会向弥萨忒贡上最漂亮的鲜花的！

say:0:1028229001:0.text: I want to get a good night's sleep and start planting tomorrow!
say:0:1028229001:0.source_cn: 我要好好睡一觉，明天一起来就去种花！

say:1:1028229002:0.text: Two rows of blue blossoms and a row of bean grass...
say:1:1028229002:0.source_cn: 两排蓝楹花……嗯，中间夹一些小豆草吧，这样更好看……

say:2:1028230001:0.source_cn: 主人，其实弥萨忒没有赐给兰迪天赋……我们要瞒着他吗？
say:2:1028230001:0.male: Magister, Misarte never gave Randy any gifts or talents... Should we tell him the truth?
say:2:1028230001:0.female: Magister, Misarte never gave Randy any gifts or talents... Should we tell him the truth?

say:3:1028230002:0.text: No, there's no need. Instead of gifts or talents, we gave him something far more important—hope.
say:3:1028230002:0.source_cn: 没关系的。比起天赋，你们给了他更重要的——希望。

say:4:1028230003:1.text: Hope is what you most long for during a journey. It may be far away, but you yearn for it wholeheartedly because, in the end, it's what you want to see the most.
say:4:1028230003:1.source_cn: 希望嘛，是你旅途中最憧憬的地方。可能很远很远，但你一心...

say:5:1028230004:1.source_cn: 让一个孩子眺望远方，找到自己向往的目标，在前往的过程中...

say:6:1028230005:1.source_cn: 到了那时候，才是天赋真正可以闪光的时刻。

say:12:1028230009:0.source_cn: 他没有为了自己哭泣，却为了那些被污染的花而流泪。一提到...

say:13:1028230010:0.source_cn: 你们知道吗？翡湖学院会给新生一枚魔法种子，它会伴着学生...

say:14:1028230011:0.text: For Randy... I think his seed will produce the most beautiful flowers Esperia will yet see.
say:14:1028230011:0.source_cn: 兰迪……我想，他的种子一定会开出最漂亮的花朵。

say:4:1028206001:0.text: All the fruit is gone! Misarte accepted my offering!
say:4:1028206001:0.source_cn: ……咦？贡果不见了！弥萨忒收下我的祭品了！

say:5:1028206002:0.text: Oh, Misarte, goddess of the earth and rivers! Please make my wish come true.
say:5:1028206002:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒，大地与河川之神，赞美您！请您倾听我的请求，实现...

say:6:1028206003:0.source_cn: 我叫兰迪，是翡湖学院的学生……这您应该已经知道了。

say:7:1028206004:0.source_cn: 我……我在学校过得不好。和同学比起来，我不太机灵，也没...

say:8:1028206005:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒，请您赐给我天赋吧，风语的能力也好，灵巧的身体也...

say:12:1028206006:0.text: Misarte... they were his fruit... We really ate his offerings!
say:12:1028206006:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒，贡果……天啊，我们真的吃了贡品！！

say:13:1028206007:0.text: And he thinks Misarte accepted the offering and will grant him his wish...
say:13:1028206007:0.source_cn: 而且他觉得弥萨忒收下了贡品，会为他实现愿望……

say:17:1028206008:0.source_cn: 嗯？周围似乎有什么动静……

say:18:1028206009:0.text: ...Misarte! Did you grant my wish already?! Do I have extra senses now?! Praise the Wildmother!
say:18:1028206009:0.source_cn: 难道说……弥萨忒，您实现了我的愿望，让我的感官变得更加...

say:19:1028206010:0.text: What gifts have you given me? The ability to speak with the wind, or perhaps some great physical strength?
say:19:1028206010:0.source_cn: 您赐予了我什么天赋？能倾听风的声音，或是强大的力量？

choice_prompt:20:1028206010.text: What gifts have you given me? The ability to speak with the wind, or perhaps some great physical strength?
choice_prompt:20:1028206010.source_cn: 您赐予了我什么天赋？能倾听风的声音，或是强大的力量？

say:21:1028206011:0.text: ... Are you testing me by staying silent? Do you want me to find out for myself?
say:21:1028206011:0.source_cn: ……您不说话，是考验我，要我自己去寻找吗？

say:22:1028206012:0.text: I understand. Maybe I'll explore tomorrow and see what I can do... Actually, why don't I go test things out right now?
say:22:1028206012:0.source_cn: 我明白了，我明天……不，我现在就去发掘自己的天赋！

say:30:1028206014:0.text: He's just a child. It's dangerous for him to go into the forest alone!
say:30:1028206014:0.source_cn: 呀，他一个小孩子，独自去森林里很危险的！

say:31:1028206015:0.text: We have to find a way to get him back to the academy!
say:31:1028206015:0.source_cn: 咱们得想办法让他回学院去！

narration:33:10282212:0.text: Randy eagerly dashes into the forest, excited to discover his talent.
narration:33:10282212:0.source_cn: 兰迪兴奋地跑进森林，准备挖掘自己的天赋。

narration:34:10282211:0.text: Before long, a young boy arrives at the Temple.
narration:34:10282211:0.source_cn: 没过多久，一个小男孩来到了供奉处。

say:4:1028209001:1.text: Oh wind, I implore you to heed my voice... share with me the wisdom of all things...
say:4:1028209001:1.source_cn: 风啊，我请求您倾听我的声音……带给我万物的讯息……

say:5:1028209002:1.text: I think this is how the Windwhisperers speak to the wind...
say:5:1028209002:1.source_cn: 风语者是这样和风对话的吧……

say:6:1028209003:0.text: But why can't I hear its voice? Have I done something wrong?
say:6:1028209003:0.source_cn: 但是，为什么听不到风的声音……是我哪里做得不对吗？

say:13:1028210001:1.text: Do you think if he feels he can hear the wind, he'll go back to the academy?
say:13:1028210001:1.source_cn: 你说，如果他听到风的声音，是不是就愿意回学院了？

say:14:1028210002:0.source_cn: 满满终于说了一句聪明话！

say:15:1028210003:0.text: Hmm... Chippy has an idea! Magister, can you summon a wind elemental for him?
say:15:1028210003:0.source_cn: 唔……嗯，有了！主人，拜托你为他召唤一只风元素好不好？
say:15:1028210003:0.male: Hmm... Chippy has an idea! Magister, can you summon a wind elemental for him?
say:15:1028210003:0.female: Hmm... Chippy has an idea! Magister, can you summon a wind elemental for him?

say:16:1028210004:1.text: If we summon one, he'll think the wind answered his call! Maybe then he'll go back to the academy.
say:16:1028210004:1.source_cn: 风元素出现，也算是他的交流成功了吧！也许这样他就能安心...

choice_prompt:17:1028210004.text: If we summon one, he'll think the wind answered his call! Maybe then he'll go back to the academy.
choice_prompt:17:1028210004.source_cn: 风元素出现，也算是他的交流成功了吧！也许这样他就能安心回学校去了？

say:22:1028210005:0.text: Look! Randy sees the wind elemental!

say:23:1028210006:0.text: He looks so happy! Now he can go home!
say:23:1028210006:0.source_cn: 他看上去很高兴！嘿嘿，这下他该心满意足了吧！

say:26:1028211001:0.text: It's the wind! You heard my call, didn't you?
say:26:1028211001:0.source_cn: 风……是风！你……你听到我的召唤了，对不对？

say:27:1028211002:1.text: Amazing! Misarte really gave me the power to speak with the wind!
say:27:1028211002:1.source_cn: 太棒了！弥萨忒真的赐予了我风语天赋！

say:28:1028211003:1.text: Could you please pass a message to my mama and papa? Just say that I can talk to the wind now. When I grow up, I will become the best Windwhisperer...
say:28:1028211003:1.source_cn: 请你传个信息给我的爸爸妈妈好不好？就说……对，就说我现...

say:29:1028211004:0.text: ...Hmm? Why is the wind blowing so strong? Please wind, heed my words, and calm down...
say:29:1028211004:0.source_cn: ……嗯？怎么风越来越大了，风啊，聆听我的话语，请你不要...

say:33:1028211005:0.text: Why does Chippy feel the wind elemental isn't very happy...
say:33:1028211005:0.source_cn: 满满怎么觉得风元素有点不太高兴……

say:34:1028211006:0.text: He can't speak to the wind at all. The elemental doesn't understand what's going on and may think it's being provoked!
say:34:1028211006:0.source_cn: 糟了，他根本不会风语。这样“沟通”，风元素可能会觉得他...

say:36:1028211007:0.text: What's happening? Listen! Please listen to me!

say:39:1028211009:0.text: Oh no, the wind elemental is going berserk! Quick! Let's go!
say:39:1028211009:0.source_cn: 不好，风元素狂暴了！快、快阻止它！

narration:41:10282223:0.text: Randy notices the wind elemental you summoned and looks delighted.
narration:41:10282223:0.source_cn: 兰迪看到了你召唤出来的风元素，似乎非常高兴。

narration:42:10282222:0.text: You and Chippy, along with Hammie, anxiously observe Randy from a distance.
narration:42:10282222:0.source_cn: 你和满满、漫漫藏在不远处，担忧地观察着兰迪。

narration:43:10282221:0.text: Upon reaching a clearing, Randy arranges the ritual once again.
narration:43:10282221:0.source_cn: 兰迪来到一片空地上，再一次布置好了仪式。
